okayama-to-takamatsu.name: Okayama ↔ Takamatsu
okayama-to-takamatsu.approx_cost: JR Rapid Marine Liner, about 52-55 min, about 2 per hour; ¥1,660 (unreserved, fare only); reserved seat supplement ¥840 per JR timetable page

takamatsu-castle-tamamo-park.name: Takamatsu Castle Ruins (Tamamo Park)
takamatsu-castle-tamamo-park.approx_cost: ¥300 adults (18+) since April 2026; under 18 free; older listings show ¥200
takamatsu-castle-tamamo-park.hours: Varies by month and by gate (summer listings 5:30-19:00; other listings 7:00-17:00 or 9:00-17:00, last entry 16:30)
takamatsu-castle-tamamo-park.best_season: Spring cherry blossoms (free night opening late March to early April)
takamatsu-castle-tamamo-park.name_local: 高松城跡 玉藻公園

takamatsu-kotohira-gu.name: Kotohira-gu (Konpira-san)
takamatsu-kotohira-gu.approx_cost: Grounds free; Treasure House, Shoin and Takahashi Yuichi Museum ¥800 each
takamatsu-kotohira-gu.hours: Grounds 6:00-18:00; main shrine doors 6:00-17:00 (to 18:00 Apr-Sep); Treasure House 8:30-17:00 (last entry 16:30); amulet office 9:00-16:00

closed.irregular: Treasure House closes irregularly for exhibit maintenance

takamatsu-kotohira-gu.address_local: 〒766-8501 香川県仲多度郡琴平町字川西1

takamatsu-naoshima.name: Naoshima art island (Chichu Art Museum)
takamatsu-naoshima.approx_cost: Chichu Art Museum ¥2,500 online / ¥2,800 on site on weekdays, ¥2,700 / ¥3,000 on weekends and holidays (15 and under free but must reserve); ticket with Night Program ¥3,700 (Fri and Sat); Benesse House Museum ¥1,200 (guide figure); ferry from Takamatsu ¥680 (car ferry) or ¥1,590 (high-speed boat) each way
takamatsu-naoshima.hours: Chichu Art Museum about 10:00-17:00 (last entry 16:00), with seasonal changes (Golden Week 2026 9:00-18:00, Aug 2026 10:00-18:00, last entry 17:00); Naoshima New Museum of Art 10:00-16:30 (last entry 16:00); Benesse House Museum 10:00-17:00 (last entry 16:30)

closed.partial: Chichu Art Museum only (long-term maintenance); other Naoshima venues open

takamatsu-naoshima.best_season: All year except the winter maintenance closures (Chichu closed 2027-01-12 to 03-19)
takamatsu-naoshima.address_local: 〒761-3110 香川県香川郡直島町北風戸積浦線

takamatsu-ritsurin-garden.name: Ritsurin Garden
takamatsu-ritsurin-garden.approx_cost: ¥500 adults, ¥170 junior-high age and under, preschoolers free; free on Jan 1 and Mar 16 (opening anniversary)
takamatsu-ritsurin-garden.hours: Varies with sunrise/sunset: May and Sep 5:30-18:30, Jun-Aug 5:30-19:00, Oct 6:00-17:30, Nov 6:30-17:00, Dec-Jan 7:00-17:00 (Feb-Apr not confirmed)
takamatsu-ritsurin-garden.best_season: Autumn night light-up in late November (2026: Nov 20-29); water lilies mid-May to late October

takamatsu-shikoku-mura.name: Shikoku Mura Museum
takamatsu-shikoku-mura.approx_cost: ¥1,600 adults, ¥1,000 university students, ¥600 junior/senior high, elementary and younger free
takamatsu-shikoku-mura.address_local: 〒761-0112 香川県高松市屋島東町屋島中町屋島スカイウェイ

takamatsu-yashima.name: Yashima plateau and Yashima-ji
takamatsu-yashima.best_season: All year; sunset views are especially popular
takamatsu-yashima.address_local: 〒761-0111 香川県高松市屋島東町屋島ドライブウェイ
